description: Improve an existing agent skill, prompt, article, plugin, workflow, or system mechanism through small reversible edits and same-task before/after comparisons. Use for requested iterative optimization, case-based validation, failure-driven improvements, or explicit invocation of autoresearch-pro. Not for one-off polishing or translation, explaining autoresearch, open-ended research, or routine development and debugging without an experiment.
